name: lightspeed
summary: Deploys the local Ansible Lightspeed assistant backed by the owned Ollama service.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reconciles the owned Lightspeed resources and AAP integration.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before rollout when Ollama, AAP, catalog, or trusted service configuration is unavailable.

readiness: The owned Lightspeed workload is ready.
The configured Ollama endpoint responds through trusted in-cluster networking.

security.secret_storage: Owned chatbot configuration uses Kubernetes secrets; model credentials are not written to the contract.
security.network_trust: AAP and Ollama integration retains certificate validation and explicit CA configuration.
security.external_actions: No cloud model provider is selected automatically.
